messages:
aj: Quick heads-up — we're rolling a small change to /v2/generate that may cause the Content-Type header to vary (some responses will be "application/json; charset=utf-8", others "text/json") on canary hosts. No schema shape change, just header variance. Want to confirm client fallback guidance before wider rollout.
rachel: Any reason we can't force application/json everywhere? proxies that inspect type break on text/json.
aj: infra says some legacy containers add charset automatically and others use a different serializer lib that emits text/json. We can normalize but it's risky during the canary window. Plan: make SDK tolerant first.
samir: Related Q: the results array will include a numeric score sometimes — what's our stance on nullable scores? Are we returning 0 or null when absent?
aj: Good call. Contract: results[] = { text: string, score: number | null, metadata?: object }. score may be null if model didn't provide a score (esp in streaming/partial responses). We'll add that to the schema registry.
vincent: For metadata: if the field is omitted, clients must treat it as absent, not an empty object. SDK will avoid coercing to {}.
rachel: Can we add an explicit example in docs showing both present and omitted metadata cases + the null score case? Helps integrators.
aj: Yep, I'll PR examples. Also suggesting the SDK accept either Content-Type and prefer application/json if both accepted by client. Add guidance: set Accept: application/json,application/*+json,text/json
devbot: deploy-bot: canary started for /v2/generate — 20% traffic us-west; link: https://deploys.internal/r/31221 (logs enabled) :eyes:
aj: Quick smoke for folks: curl example to test tolerant parsing — use this to validate proxies:```bash
curl -v -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
samir: For streaming clients, will we sometimes emit ndjson? or remain single JSON only?
aj: No ndjson change for this rollout — streaming still uses chunked JSON objects with the same shape; only header variance for full responses. If we decide to support ndjson later we'll coordinate.
api-bot: Reminder — update schema-registry entry /v2/generate: add "score": {"type":["number","null"]}, "metadata": {"nullable":true, "optional":true} and a short release note.
vincent: SDK owners: plan to add fallback for text/json + expose score as number | null in typed clients. Ping me if you need test vectors.
rachel: thumbs up — I'll watch the canary for proxy errors and post results here. :thumbsup: 
aj: Thanks — will follow up with a PR link (examples + schema) and a canary health update in ~30m. :shrug:
